steps: Find and correct the cause - glucose, Na, Ca, uraemia, hypercapnia, ammonia, drugs, hypoxia, sepsis.
Empirical thiamine in at-risk patients; naloxone if opioid suspected.
Treat the underlying organ failure; review/stop offending drugs.

confirm: Diffuse alteration of consciousness without focal deficit; asterixis, myoclonus. Identify the metabolic cause.

investigations.test: Glucose, U&E, Ca, LFTs, ammonia, ABG
